{{Top|leg}}
'''Uglejig''' was a type of [[Music/Legends|music]] produced by the [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaughts]]. [[Ugloste/Legends|Ugloste]] associated the sounds of uglejig music, along with the scent of [[roast greeg pie]], as being welcomed home.<ref name="SWTSE">''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]''</ref>
